Peter, I
have a heartwarming story for you. It’s about glasses.

At my old health department in Wayne County, we'd test kids for vision
problems in school. A lot of times, the slip telling parents their child
needed glasses never made it home — or, it did make it home, but there was
no money to do anything about it.

To get these kids the glasses they needed, we put optometrists in vans
outside of schools to give free vision tests. Then, we’d ship them a pair
of glasses in two weeks. We delivered 10,000 free glasses through this
program.

There’s one boy I distinctly remember — we had just given him a pair of
glasses, he tried them on, and said: “I’ve got wrinkles in my hand!”

I had to show him my hand. Then everybody else's. He couldn't believe we
all had wrinkles on our hands!

He was seeing clearly for the first time in his life,
Peter. And that makes a huge
difference, especially for a young kid in school.

This is what our government is supposed to do:

1. See the problem.
2. Remove the obstacle.
3. Deliver.

When corporate PACs buy control over our democracy, you get politicians
who prioritize profits over people.

This system is broken, and I know how to fix it. That’s why I’m running
for Senate: To fight for working people and make a tangible impact for our
communities.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260614-1-ak.1nOpv6&amount=10&refcode=em20260614-2349&t=1004&akid=2368%2E251025%2Ep89smS ]With you by my side, we can make progress like this on an even greater
scale in the U.S. Senate. But first, we have to win.
Peter, can you
chip in $10 to fuel our campaign?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260614-1-ak.1nOpv6&amount=10&refcode=em20260614-2349&t=1023&akid=2368%2E251025%2Ep89smS ]Donate $10 ››

In solidarity,

Abdul

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Jane told the Post that what's happening in America today is more dangerous than anything she's witnessed — graver, even, than the McCarthyism that once targeted her father.
**“What’s happening now in this country is much more grave, much more serious than what was happening back in the late ‘40s and early ‘50s...Everything is different now, because the rules of democracy, the laws that we, I’m afraid to say, maybe took for granted ... are being taken away.”** _— Jane Fonda, speaking to The Washington Post_

clean_body: Here's everything you need to know this month. | Welcome to the June edition of The JanePAC Monthly. We're heading into the thick of the midterms with real momentum on our side. From hard-fought primary victories to Jane's latest stand against the Trump administration, this movement is showing exactly what grassroots power looks like. Here's everything you need to know this month. 👇 🏆 A JANEPAC VICTORY WORTH CELEBRATING The past few weeks delivered primary win after primary win for our climate champions — but one deserves a spotlight today: Randy Villegas. Randy earned enough votes to advance to the general election in California’s 22nd District — bringing us one step closer to flipping this seat and taking back the House in November! = This is huge for our climate movement. Randy beat an opponent backed by a flood of corporate cash and the Washington establishment. Now he faces David Valadao in November — one of the most vulnerable Republicans in America. Valadao looked Central Valley families in the eye and promised he'd never cut Medicaid, then voted for Trump's budget bill that did exactly that. The Central Valley has gone without a real climate champion for too long, and Randy is the leader these communities deserve. = | = 🗓️ AN EVENING WITH JANE FONDA & DAVID HOGG Mark your calendar. On Tuesday, July 14th , Jane is teaming up with David Hogg — activist and founder of Leaders We Deserve — for a virtual conversation about the future of our country, why primaries matter, and what it takes to elect leaders brave enough to meet this moment. And you’re invited to be part of it! = = = ✊ WEAR THE RESISTANCE Some images say more than words ever could. Jane's iconic mugshot from 1970 has become a symbol of what it means to refuse to back down. We put it on a tee because that spirit belongs to all of us. When you wear it, you're carrying a piece of this movement with you and reminding the world that resistance never goes out of style. 🌍 CLIMATE NEWS: TRUMP'S COAL OBSESSION Just when you thought it couldn't get worse, Donald Trump announced he is pouring $700 million in federal money into reviving dirty coal, including the first new coal plants in this country in over a decade. Trump Offers Funds for First New U.S. Coal Plants in 13 Years \- The New York Times Let’s be clear: coal is the most polluting fossil fuel there is, and experts agree it's more expensive than gas or renewables. But Trump doesn't care about facts. He cares about his Big Oil billionaire buddies who profit from pollution. 📰 JANE IN THE NEWS The Washington Post sat down with Jane this month, and her message landed with the weight of six decades of activism behind it. Jane told the Post that what's happening in America today is more dangerous than anything she's witnessed — graver, even, than the McCarthyism that once targeted her father. “What’s happening now in this country is much more grave, much more serious than what was happening back in the late ‘40s and early ‘50s...Everything is different now, because the rules of democracy, the laws that we, I’m afraid to say, maybe took for granted ... are being taken away.” — Jane Fonda, speaking to The Washington Post But Jane isn't backing down. She's relaunched the free speech committee her father once belonged to, and she's as certain as ever that strikes, boycotts, and people refusing to stay silent are exactly what works. As she put it: the zeitgeist has shifted, and we intend to keep it moving. 📰 GOTV WITH JANE When Jane launched her Climate PAC, she promised to do what it takes to break the fossil fuel industry’s stranglehold on our politics. Sometimes, we win. Sometimes, we lose. But we never sit on the sidelines — because this work has always been about standing with the leaders who believe a better future is possible and are willing to fight for it. Jake Levine is one of those leaders. Jane was proud to headline a canvass for Jake last month in California’s 32nd Congressional District, and while he didn’t advance through a tough primary, we never stopped believing in him or the movement he helped build. = | = ---|--- That's it for this edition of The JanePAC Monthly. Thank you for being part of this movement. If you want to stay plugged in between newsletters, follow us on social media for daily updates and behind-the-scenes moments with Jane and the team: Together, we are building a movement they cannot ignore. And we're just getting started. In solidarity, – Team JanePAC = | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. subject: This is the moment most people never see
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heroes for Humanity
body:
That is the moment most people never see, and the moment Heroes for Humanity was built for.

A girl named "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere.
| | | | | |
---
[ ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM1qtTAYhK8m7pT8Gc-3yOKjB6GL02W7lBhfTcD8kLxazt0XS3sB3Q0zw_AwH4_pYfzu4_ZmAmh7-qnUCZ2vvqKDkAJEDKlihpR3mDjlqqWqZfLqsWbRdlGCN6DZcGOyl4rTxmlp_8kZKFt7RSUb7MDALJTTGZhlM1eN19cSVUwyJSgT3dCDuUHP6bqu_SAokfTIi0GonU2xQjkN-hN8jOlSKXY2hWbXDjFXIv4TPhI-LikahA4dOCgJ6pqKO4KJHp9dKhvho5nnZ20rpvJsq0sFp9zmlIkYC9ijFB83Iu5YDiBcHRgmtETcX95feftL_BPYFBEiEnGHYPzOmqKX_On33Vc1EEm3y_2mxL__emr-FQAA__94o4kY)
---
Friend,
"Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. Nobody was helping. In her words, she was flabbergasted and lost, terrified for her daughter, with no idea what to do next.
**That is the moment most people never see, and the moment Heroes for Humanity was built for.**
We sent operators in. They started surveillance, built intelligence on the ground, and narrowed the search to a single area. Within 24 hours of our operator arriving, we had a confirmed sighting.
Shortly after, he picked her up, called her mother, notified local police, and brought her home.
**Her mother said it plainly: without our team, nothing would have happened. It would have stayed exactly as it was, or gotten far worse.**
I want to be honest with you about why this is so rare.
You can likely count on one hand the number of nonprofits in this country that actually go hands-on – that physically go in and bring a child out. Most cannot.
**The backbone of Heroes for Humanity is veteran special operators trained to find people who do not want to be found, anywhere in the world.** We use those same skills to find missing and trafficked children, here at home and abroad, and to physically return them to their families.
"Abby" is one story among many. We recovered **9 children in California in 2023** , identified more than **8 trafficked children** in our work last year, and brought home **three more teenagers from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas** this past January. Each one is a name, a face, a family. And each one is the reason the next call cannot go unanswered.
_And trafficking is only one front._ The same operators who find these children went behind enemy lines to bring families home from Afghanistan, stood up evacuations in active war zones in the Middle East, and put food in the hands of a thousand people a day in Zambia – all while carrying the Gospel into the darkest places on earth.
**Precision rescue, humanitarian aid, and the hope of Jesus Christ. That is the whole of who we are.**
---
---
**My name is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments, writing to you as Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. **We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Today we are a 501(c)(3) network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work in the trenches that most organizations cannot.
[ **I’d like to ask you to directly support these critical efforts, but I also want to pull back the curtain a bit to share with you exactly how this all works.** ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM1qtTAYhK8m7pT8Gc-3yOKjB6GL02W7lBhfTcD8kLxazt0XS3sB3Q0zw_AwH4_pYfzu4_ZmAmh7-qnUCZ2vvqKDkAJEDKlihpR3mDjlqqWqZfLqsWbRdlGCN6DZcGOyl4rTxmlp_8kZKFt7RSUb7MDALJTTGZhlM1eN19cSVUwyJSgT3dCDuUHP6bqu_SAokfTIi0GonU2xQjkN-hN8jOlSKXY2hWbXDjFXIv4TPhI-LikahA4dOCgJ6pqKO4KJHp9dKhvho5nnZ20rpvJsq0sFp9zmlIkYC9ijFB83Iu5YDiBcHRgmtETcX95feftL_BPYFBEiEnGHYPzOmqKX_On33Vc1EEm3y_2mxL__emr-FQAA__94o4kY) We've put together a short video, with an intro from my dear friend Chad Robichaux, that gets into the tactics, the operators, and the full story of how we brought "Abby" home. [ **Watch it here >>** ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM1qtTAYhK8m7pT8Gc-3yOKjB6GL02W7lBhfTcD8kLxazt0XS3sB3Q0zw_AwH4_pYfzu4_ZmAmh7-qnUCZ2vvqKDkAJEDKlihpR3mDjlqqWqZfLqsWbRdlGCN6DZcGOyl4rTxmlp_8kZKFt7RSUb7MDALJTTGZhlM1eN19cSVUwyJSgT3dCDuUHP6bqu_SAokfTIi0GonU2xQjkN-hN8jOlSKXY2hWbXDjFXIv4TPhI-LikahA4dOCgJ6pqKO4KJHp9dKhvho5nnZ20rpvJsq0sFp9zmlIkYC9ijFB83Iu5YDiBcHRgmtETcX95feftL_BPYFBEiEnGHYPzOmqKX_On33Vc1EEm3y_2mxL__emr-FQAA__94o4kY)
**And know this, when you give today, you’re not just funding some generic mission. You’re directly funding tangible programs.** Right now, the two that are front and center are as follows:
**➡️ Our July operator course. **This July we launch the next course in our training pipeline, where candidates are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure and trained in the fieldcraft, intelligence work, and crisis response the mission demands. This is where operators are made. Rescues like the one you just read about do not happen without it.
**➡️ The National Training Center. **For five years we've done this work from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way. So we're building a permanent home for the mission in our home state of Texas – standardized certification for every operator we field, medical and trauma training for austere environments, an intelligence and mission-planning hub, and the capacity to train the next generation at scale.
**Long story short, your gift today funds the brick and mortar place, and the training, that puts the right person in the field when the next call comes.**
[ **A donation of any amount would be a true blessing – even $25. The next missing child is already out there. Please, help us be ready.** ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM1qtTAYhK8m7pT8Gc-3yOKjB6GL02W7lBhfTcD8kLxazt0XS3sB3Q0zw_AwH4_pYfzu4_ZmAmh7-qnUCZ2vvqKDkAJEDKlihpR3mDjlqqWqZfLqsWbRdlGCN6DZcGOyl4rTxmlp_8kZKFt7RSUb7MDALJTTGZhlM1eN19cSVUwyJSgT3dCDuUHP6bqu_SAokfTIi0GonU2xQjkN-hN8jOlSKXY2hWbXDjFXIv4TPhI-LikahA4dOCgJ6pqKO4KJHp9dKhvho5nnZ20rpvJsq0sFp9zmlIkYC9ijFB83Iu5YDiBcHRgmtETcX95feftL_BPYFBEiEnGHYPzOmqKX_On33Vc1EEm3y_2mxL__emr-FQAA__94o4kY)
Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – to free the oppressed, so others may live.
Respectfully submitted,

Dennis Price Founder & CEO Heroes for Humanity

I had no idea how much this fight would grow. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133323027/627477366/-1748637495?refcode=em_JJR_FR_Momentum_061426&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmMzYmZiNTgtMGU2OC1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WY2EIYT3XxjrZ0B6F0XJ4YnITgaHDgT-WDd56WfaMZc=) Since then, I’ve traveled across this state and talked to thousands of Floridians who are ready for change. From families who feel like no one in Tallahassee is fighting for them. And I’ve seen something that fires me up every single day: People aren’t giving up. They’re showing up and demanding better. That energy is building into something real, and the numbers prove it: **_The latest poll has us LEADING James Uthmeier, 42.8% to 39.6%._** Peter, we are in this race to win, and it’s all thanks to grassroots supporters like you. But momentum only carries us so far without the resources to back it up. | | | | | | 📣 **Legislative, Budget & Campaign Update **📄Good morning, Arizona!Last weekend, the House and Senate leadership reached a budget agreement with the Executive. Budget bills were introduced earlier in the week, followed by a joint Appropriations hearing on Wednesday, and full floor votes on Thursday. The Governor signed the budget yesterday. Keep in mind: our fiscal year ends on June 30th. You can read the budget bills [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=09bd08e931&e=a7ab36849c).
Arizona remains the only state in the nation to fully deliver the federal tax cuts approved by Congress last year — while shrinking government, protecting school choice, fully funding public safety and transportation priorities, and imposing no new taxes or fees in a divided government.More importantly, Arizonans will not have to refile their tax returns because this budget fully conforms with federal tax provisions. We remain committed to providing meaningful relief to families facing rising costs.💰 **Budget Highlights** The $18.29 billion state budget delivers $1.45 billion in tax relief over four years, while keeping spending growth 3.05% below the combined rate of population and economic growth.Tax relief package includes:
* 💵 No tax on tips
* ⏱️ No tax on overtime
* 📈 Increased standard deduction
* 👶 New childcare deduction
* 👨👩👧 Enhanced child tax credit
* ❤️ Expanded charitable giving deductions
* 🎖️ Property tax relief for veterans

💡 **Accountability Measures**
* 🔍 Enhanced eligibility verification for Medicaid and SNAP
* 🧾 Stronger oversight to ensure taxpayer dollars are used properly

📊 JLBC May Fiscal Highlights
JLBC reports General Fund revenues are 3.5% above the prior year. You can read their report [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=5e4c08ad75&e=a7ab36849c). JLBC reports General Fund revenues are 3.5% above the prior year.
After 145 days in session and 2,157 bills introduced, the Fifty‐seventh Legislature, Second Regular Session adjourned Sine Die at 10:06 a.m. yesterday.
🗳️ **Additional Ballot Referrals Heading to Voters** This November, voters will have the opportunity to:
* Protect military families 🇺🇸
* Secure our elections 🗳️
* Direct more education dollars into classrooms 📚
* Banning affirmative action and DEI ✅
* Saving girls only sports **🏐**
* Ban photo radar 📹
* Ensure taxpayer‐funded school resources are used for students 🎒

These ballot referrals share a common goal: protecting girls and families, strengthening accountability, improving election processes, and ensuring public dollars serve their intended purpose.🎖️ **Protecting Scholarship Funds for Military Families** This measure safeguards scholarship funds for children of military families. These are their dollars, and no one should ever take them away. You can read this ballot measure [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=37dc6861a2&e=a7ab36849c).🗳️ **Securing the Integrity of Our Elections** Earlier this session, I sponsored SCR 1001. This bill requires proof of citizenship, voter ID, banning foreign donations in our elections, and giving voters the option to tabulate their ballots, speeding up election results.The House mirror bill passed, so this measure is headed to the ballot. I have sponsored this legislation each session since 2024 to no avail. You can read the ballot measure [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=17095136d1&e=a7ab36849c).📘 **Classroom Spending Accountability Act** This measure requires large school districts with at least 7,500 students to spend at least 60% of operational dollars on direct instructional expenses, with consequences for repeated noncompliance. You can read the ballot measure [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a057736327&e=a7ab36849c).🚫 **Banning affirmative action and DEI** Voters will have a chance come November to put the strongest protections against race-based discrimination and diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) into our state’s constitution by constitutionally prohibiting the state from compelling or spending public monies on DEI. You can read the measure [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2d527966b5&e=a7ab36849c).**!!️**[**B**](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=7020ba30f4&e=a7ab36849c)**an photo radar** This measure prohibits a local authority or **state** agency from using a photo enforcement system to identify violators of speed. [Here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3011bc0690&e=a7ab36849c) is the ballot measure language.**👧🏻 Saving girls only sports 🤼♀️**This common sense measure requires school-sponsored interscholastic and intramural athletic teams to be designated as male, female, or coeducational based on biological sex. It also strengthens privacy protections by prohibiting schools and athletic associations from allowing individuals to use private athletic facilities that are not designated for their sex. You can read it [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=43fe363e64&e=a7ab36849c).🎒 **Keeping Taxpayer Resources Focused on Students** Prohibits school districts from using taxpayer‐funded resources to support labor organization activities by banning taxpayer funding of teacher unions, for performing labor organization activities during the working hours, and banning organized sick-outs. You can read the language [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=03da1c3693&e=a7ab36849c).📝 **Help support or oppose a ballot measure** If you feel strongly for or against one of these listed measures, you can submit a ballot argument at [https://ballotarguments.az.gov](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c237ef3d71&e=a7ab36849c) There is an associated online fee of $75 per submitted ballot measure argument. The deadline to submit an argument is by 5pm on June 24th. Happy writing!
🌎 **Recent Events & Engagements**Two weekends ago, I attended Young Americans for Liberty’s “IGNITE: Liberty for a Lifetime” as a 2020 Hazlitt Fellow to discuss school choice with liberty‐minded legislators nationwide.Last week, I traveled to Philadelphia for a Republican women’s public leadership summit, where we focused on emerging policy issues — including the rapid rise of AI in daily life. Just being in the birthplace of our nation was a strong reminder that liberty isn’t inherited—it must be preserved and passed on. If you haven’t visited Independence Hall, I highly recommend making the trip. It is America’s 250! Seeing Independence Hall—where both the Declaration of Independence and the United States Constitution were debated and adopted—offers a powerful connection to our Nation’s founding. It was an honor to reflect on the principles that shaped America: liberty, self-government, personal responsibility, and the enduring promise of the American Dream.
💪🏻 **Campaign Endorsements** 👮 **Backing the Blue** The Arizona Police Association endorsed my campaign for State Senate. I have consistently supported public safety and opposed efforts to defund the police.🏪 **Championing Small Businesses** The National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) endorsed my candidacy based on my voting record on key tax and regulatory issues.🏡 **Protecting Private Property Rights** The REALTORS® of Arizona PAC (RAPAC) endorsed my campaign for defending property rights, free markets, and smart regulation.💻 **Arizona Technology Council** Endorsed my candidacy for supporting Arizona’s innovation economy and STEM workforce — a personal priority, as both of my children graduated from ASU with STEM degrees.🚓 **Arizona State Troopers Association** Endorsed my campaign based on my commitment to public safety, integrity, and consistent support for DPS employees.
🗳️ **Important Primary Election Information**
* Last day to register: June 22
* Early voting begins: June 24
* Mail‐in ballots mailed: June 24 (Active Early Voting List)
* Primary Election Day: July 21

If you’re an Arizona resident and not yet registered, now is the time to ensure your voice is heard.
📣 **Campaign Update** If you live in District 2, you may have noticed our large campaign signs sprouting up along major intersections across the district. If you live in LD2 and would like to request a yard sign, please request one [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=62e4ee0033&e=a7ab36849c).If you would like to volunteer for our campaign, please let us know by [emailing me](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c37c6536ee&e=a7ab36849c). Now that my work at the legislature is behind me until we get a call into special session to address water, I will be focused most of my “free” time campaigning throughout the district and raising money to properly invest in this election to help hold our slim Republican majority. Stay tuned.Thank you for your continued support!Best,Shawnna

Your No-BS NewsletterDear Readers,Today's sponsor, Sound of Freedom Foundation, is supporting organizations that work to prevent child trafficking, protect vulnerable children, and help survivors rebuild their lives through long-term care, advocacy, and restoration.Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors.
The Just The Truth Team
* * *
GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALEFriend,She was just a child.And the person who should have protected her was the one who first trafficked her.Her own mother.What began there didn’t stop. She was sold again and again.Passed between people who saw her as an object.Not a child.
Not a life.
Not someone worth protecting.[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/B5dGM86ifXFP4ja8MNjELQnXcm7ID670zfpOaZw1Sx6qLEGXTKJAIz8qdgPE%0AnkIINBosdjrTG3YO8fp7w38HE0DP4X7XT6ZbHTYGQ%2BZ9pGgC6O4UQeZZ2M90%0AzGQcAkaGn1xe6EYi3pFe%2FnlKK26A1GSEzZDqyEsw%2Bdo39MsvOrwL1ZkSnv9V%0ADNE4NbQdFUghfMXyFC5B7I%2BpTskJlJ9CCA%3D%3D%0A/a8705e2372e1aed5)[Protect Children And Restore Hope](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/DY1UuqELHujXH%2Ft7HAXDp9ftOhvmX3qjAXmEWcO7CLg%2FlbG5WzZ7b%2FUpFcSm%0AWQORueMeOVRe1OkR1SKXhp0QMqzXA8T%2FhiIwnGjRs2SDeq16Avy3MAr%2Fuz5w%0AUPOXpZdGDbiqc0KW6CBNqSG1C%2Fp9A4bytbfd8%2Fx2yg3NXUvrEDy2amiIGEvw%0AJ5EU8snoJ6zu58j6v4MVnVihVVuHdHcJqw%3D%3D%0A/a32f991aca1b63ec)As the years went on, the trauma only grew deeper.To survive, she turned to addiction—the only way to numb the pain. The only way to keep going.She even had children with one of the men who trafficked her.Another chain and reason it felt impossible to escape.For years, she lived in fear. No way out. Until one day, she reached a breaking point.With nothing but courage and fear in her heart, she ran, fleeing to a women’s shelter.No plan. No safety.
**Just hope that maybe someone would help her.****And that is when everything began to change.****Because someone did show up.** A partner of the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** called House Parent Project. They didn’t turn her away. They didn’t question her worth.**They sat with her, they listened and believed her. And in that moment, light entered her story.**[Protect Children And Restore Hope](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/%2BqaNUXVy8LiAqO%2F8He4QuBb5Yv%2Bq7SAaAxyE13aGCSCSBy1a1OWrDwaDdeNe%0AxK3TOeD19XZBGcwfOyNKsFK4Xva%2BU0B1XlCbc5BhZFWl6pI88icfwHrhKlAi%0AWe%2B6FVlgGiDwNgzFBDh2tGwGeV%2B%2Fv5%2FPDx%2FcPaDAfNhE9P12tmLanEOAC3G2%0AF0RUelAD3qr63qt2Sv6lkOlZ7o6jSYjoDQ%3D%3D%0A/a4966912edaebcd9)They helped her take the next step. Then the next. And the next.They safely relocated her far from the people who had controlled her life.**For the first time in years, she could breathe.** She could begin to heal. But they didn’t stop there.They are still walking with her today, because her fight is not over.Her children are still connected to the man who trafficked her. And now, Sara is fighting to bring them to safety. Fighting to break the cycle for good.And she is not alone.Friend, maybe this is your first time hearing about us.The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists for one reason:**_To stop the sale of God’s children._** We were born from the true story told in the film _Sound of Freedom_ , but this mission did not end when the credits rolled.It became a movement.Today, we work around the world to **prevent trafficking before it starts.****We support partners that help rescue children in danger, support survivors on their long road to healing, and fight for laws that protect the innocent.**[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/Wn20Ac%2BvYJ7SVXshAdCBvouOOZ2e362TaYrIt3jQdWAgiCzIO37NQmED1P7N%0ABMA8iRYqdhH1GlAZgWbLiiNRwX71uADydZPiSDf5aczTYasvbWVgEO6r%2BFBN%0A1PcXVTAf6Ic4hqCrOJl%2Ffx8R2HCaF8%2Bl5gBtj6XUccQzno7a7QrrN4ujXuFp%0A3rbrmrovg6FtJMdnbXaG3fs%2FZGBaZreJ9Q%3D%3D%0A/f15498dac8e37783)**Because rescue is only the beginning.** Children need safety, healing and someone to walk with them on the long road ahead.**And that is what your support makes possible.****Not just escape. But restoration. A future rebuilt.** You see, Friend, **Sound of Freedom Foundation’s** mission is simple:**_To stop the sale of God’s children._** We extend the reach of the _Sound of Freedom_ film, shining a light on how real and widespread child trafficking is and what we must do to stop it.**We believe in a future where this evil is gone.****_A world where every child is safe and truly free._** Jesus said, _“Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me.”_ (Matthew 18:5)**Today you have the chance to be part of that welcome and be part of that light.**[Protect Children And Restore Hope](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/MQT9omZI4u4%2FgvX%2Fm65m5bp7LaiirXAESBcwHqhuQGF8PK%2FyzUheon8kU%2BH6%0AiqvkauAL7yE8BF2IT3913TcaKqHv0IbdZHCM%2FBtVATmv67OAGZZzXZieESMp%0A%2F%2FWya4OJFpP0L3liw%2B0GK5OQSOeX7qXXb96Xan53Y6%2F5E5M1LCZ4cRzNVyXA%0AefK%2BgdqGKClM7hcvv9eVckVJfovEWjSWFA%3D%3D%0A/cfdd69ac3797b420)Your gift today can help:**$25** — Support immediate outreach and response
**$50** — Provide critical care and stabilization
**$75** — Help relocate and protect a survivor
**$100** — Support ongoing care and legal advocacy**Because healing takes time.**
**Protection takes people.**
**And freedom takes courage from all of us.**[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/quLDh4QT7Zzv96zo6yeZDobTbRk8E9mlx8xXha8f3gs2EFBQEZLr%2BiJp7MzO%0Anp%2Byw54YgOvCrczvyj15%2FWKlp77%2BWcl1pl7U9pB8rFg6135TI5xYJR6UYJG0%0AwriKDeQnL%2BD5agwLxNjEy0TC431MiARTdkuEYsNAzbqmw5OtmFkux6JiBBNJ%0AjzrtWmwmd7FUVyoaoKqY%2BLNtbpO5oNDdew%3D%3D%0A/fe780dc0c0224760) You can step in and help rewrite stories like Sara’s.Please give as generously as you can today.And please pray...**For Sara.**
**For her children.**
**And for every child still waiting for someone to show up.**[Protect Children And Restore Hope](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/u0Fv9KhFqZnd6n1%2F0uRE54dEPi3sduFBlIOHY0JvKi1ED3kO0sms9uQ7epFZ%0AL%2FoySUtL3mv2ou6kBRlaAS6ZN5drSuRZIJetUpICSSkWJy1PRR95bi%2FrdA43%0AfLgiKu0zC0qW135%2Bte2CgH%2BelzM96sxw42hvONSk7E5%2Fv537JvEUthahB3es%0AkQAzXrEN7BBqmPT8wsgktR%2F3cCsMh59lRA%3D%3D%0A/077aeab2676f1247)** _Because God’s children are not for sale._** And together... we will not stop fighting for them.For God’s Children,[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/W2V3DrQ34vVlAFZFYlBgx80pLKK8EiJ56AhdhzkmfsP1G7LjLpKnrCKFhcGs%0A99GJB6IVPIcgLH0r49x570EZMf3tYru4rPZP4kX1DkQZY6%2BfjfffrplJfaRM%0AHa85cO4kph91XwDgfn2HWxjc3J9%2FGWAmU8jaCMHlh5HnK0xRhfcTbtHKmUNZ%0A7%2BmofB84OU6vdm%2Bu4Cwc7AcusfUssPH9Zg%3D%3D%0A/ec73d061d6fb9fd2)Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer

body:
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/]
Friend,

On the 250th anniversary of our great democratic experiment, Flag Day is a powerful reminder of what it means to be part of something bigger than ourselves.

Here in Maryland, our communities are built on a rich tradition of service. We see it every day in the neighbors who step up to look out for one another, our local organizers, and our public servants who work tirelessly behind the scenes to move our state forward.

The flag represents the shared values that unite us across our differences—the commitment to protecting our fundamental rights, expanding opportunity, and building a stronger, more equitable future for the next generation.

Today, as we celebrate that enduring legacy, thank you for your continued dedication to our community and for being a vital part of this journey.

Happy Flag Day,

Sarah Elfreth
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/] https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD [https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD] https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland [https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland] https://x.com/SarahforMD [https://x.com/SarahforMD]
Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. Sarah lives in Annapolis with her fiancé, Eric, and their dog, Ollie. body:
| | | | Derek, I want you to hear this from me. **I am officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of Alabama.** I’m honored. I’m grateful. And I’m ready for this fight. Over the last several months, we’ve traveled across this state listening to people in every corner of Alabama. What I heard was clear: folks are tired of being ignored. Tired of leaders who treat politics like a performance while families struggle to afford groceries, health care, housing, and the basics of everyday life. This race has never been about political games for me. It’s about whether working people in Alabama have someone fighting for them again. And now, we begin the most important phase of this campaign. Tommy Tuberville has outside money, special interests, and the full weight of the Montgomery political establishment behind him. We’re building something different. A grassroots campaign powered by people who believe Alabama deserves better. When I won my Senate race, we shocked the nation because people came together across party lines and refused to settle for the politics of division and cynicism. We proved Alabama could do better. Now, we’re going to do it again. But winning this race will take every single one of us. clean_body: | | | | Derek, I want you to hear this from me. I am officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of Alabama. I’m honored. I’m grateful. And I’m ready for this fight. Over the last several months, we’ve traveled across this state listening to people in every corner of Alabama. What I heard was clear: folks are tired of being ignored. Tired of leaders who treat politics like a performance while families struggle to afford groceries, health care, housing, and the basics of everyday life. This race has never been about political games for me. It’s about whether working people in Alabama have someone fighting for them again. And now, we begin the most important phase of this campaign. Tommy Tuberville has outside money, special interests, and the full weight of the Montgomery political establishment behind him. We’re building something different. A grassroots campaign powered by people who believe Alabama deserves better. When I won my Senate race, we shocked the nation because people came together across party lines and refused to settle for the politics of division and cynicism. We proved Alabama could do better. Now, we’re going to do it again. But winning this race will take every single one of us. subject: Can we have a moment of your time?

body:
Pramila is on the frontlines of our fights — to keep going, we need your support before midnight tomorrow.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260614-6351-footer&t=1&akid=6351%2E420207%2E-eVIm2)
The countdown is on, Peter.
We have until midnight tomorrow night to reach [**our $18,000 mid-month fundraising goal**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260614.9RD2XH&refcode=em20260614-6351&amount=3&t=2&akid=6351%2E420207%2E-eVIm2), and we need your support to get there.
We’re living through a tough moment — there’s no denying that. Gas, rent, and grocery prices are through the roof. Healthcare is out of reach for millions of Americans. Working people are struggling to survive the chaos manufactured by this cruel administration, while billionaires get richer, Elon Musk becomes the first trillionaire, and corporations write the rules in their favor.
**Every generation has its test. This is ours, and Pramila is on the frontlines of the fight.**
She’s on the House floor every single day fighting for Medicare for All, immigrant rights, fair wages, an end to Trump’s illegal war in Iran, and a government that finally puts working people first.
Her work is sustained by grassroots supporters like you, chipping in what they can, when they can. And that’s who her obligation is to — this movement, and the people in it.
With the midterms growing closer and Pramila’s reelection campaign officially launched, we need to make sure her pathway to November is as strong as possible.
The resources we raise right now will help power Pramila’s re-election campaign and keep our people-powered movement strong. That’s why hitting our **$18,000 mid-month goal** is critical.
[**Can we count on you to pitch in $3, or whatever is meaningful to you, to help us get there before midnight tomorrow night?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260614.9RD2XH&refcode=em20260614-6351&amount=3&t=3&akid=6351%2E420207%2E-eVIm2)

Thank you for showing up and standing with us.
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

name: Alexis
subject: Why I’m calling to ban AI data centers
body:
Rolling Stone just covered our campaign | | | Dear Friend,
Our campaign for Congress and the fight to ban AI data centers was featured in Rolling Stone!

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMe2DDuSXMSVR6-yo9jnkdfVDpjqb-G_bN9KWoqggDUKToxLF1D2C5OWdxbWawInpObrLsU-85F4QCSwNYvWkpu6eibXC0DbZY-DchYLFwc2bIHjtuNQtAt_eZxXZ6knA6KWngihANd5oz5cPKxXiDgsx96vFUK4NSwc6RhEhQOY9FgBm-yIcmg7XuUjBwAvSoANjBSGvSRM_OOTNS0aHCu-OfU-iOEZEQopKFG4wavEuAI68I2xokj5gV5jktFDD6o708tu6eSD0MNQKeq0PbVlGEZrWDsi7nKVd_m4LfyDRIu47LCyY8OdSHz1v4_KtC0RSb9LEFJIq3gkfFjxCgrc8NqA4VLz-GZrDz2aM8beXGE8oGxia6CXqtjVjz9FJPA/4rh/ia_bRuaTRYKXF6FHyWN2WA/h0/h001.A560cyNkiz-mT2iIOxulpYg-g-gmnq4c996irTv3Xb0)

You can read the full article [here](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMe2DDuSXMSVR6-yo9jnkdfVDpjqb-G_bN9KWoqggDUKToxLF1D2C5OWdxbWawInpObrLsU-85F4QCSwNYvWkpu6eibXC0DbZY-DchYLFwc2bIHjtuNQtAt_eZxXZ6knA6KWngihANd5oz5cPKxXiDgvy1UfD6mh99_V2FPDHYWK_qTulQarEtvjrwlplDmjRJSJ_RR-H-Y4vLqwKp_vcWenjXvayZNtwt9thoMzaxghT3GpeKXbsGv9r6pbW9OtU47Db1-U0SK1pwyb-TrB-YgmKcjMws7XB51PbvFeA8sDhtBbxZDSbrSrR4Pjax_JKDaZZZLmIdJLsD76wOnDyOasse63OtLuRGg-9lcWfoC2nivWyT56USnvGLcL534Pz-g/4rh/ia_bRuaTRYKXF6FHyWN2WA/h1/h001.aIDNGJjr_XOf8JcOWsgRQNJNimlvLJYHd-43GEAnrLk).
This national attention matters because what’s happening in Maryland’s 6th District is part of a much bigger fight.
Big Tech is asking our communities to sacrifice land, water, energy, and public money for projects that enrich billionaires while giving working families very little in return.
I’ve seen this pattern before.
I worked on Wall Street during the 2008 financial crisis. Later, at the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, I fought crypto scams and corporate abuse. And what I’m seeing now — massive debt, wild hype, and powerful people insisting the normal rules should not apply — sets off every alarm bell.
We cannot afford to hand out tax breaks and public resources to Big Tech while our communities need schools, libraries, rec centers, housing, health care, and clean water.
That’s why this campaign matters.

**[But getting this message to voters takes resources. Every dollar we raise helps us reach more people before Election Day. Can you chip in $25, $50, or $100 today to help us get this message in front of more voters?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquAGPPmBLrmFBuC7KfMrIKc0N-Z9tqvVP7y9m_u1LepFgFXDJpFB0RxLTSayn15MEkoGAjBmOiL7mK75RV4U0t6pfhHPePgPG0LJfYzprC1Y8ClW3IMCtgtYGjBSoNB_RDLzqpnU4zvdlr0cxrKG24Y2t152WxoMZcD2_IiGwzVplRtKG9LltJ4rGlMVOP0Tck4U8jgmsKaDYM0Y5Z9R-IQE28rMooDQmnKHcattygVtWqWYtX08HU3I37Fke5NvwpQ5NUtQ-e8VRUAP50BmU00H8-RVh__A24lVO1-TvFMzw/4rh/ia_bRuaTRYKXF6FHyWN2WA/h2/h001.7OTkVetF5p7JUbzMoiX9c-muiC3N3e7YDa_L_bB2za0)**
This Rolling Stone feature gives us a real opening. Now we need to turn that attention into action.
Please donate today and help us keep building the campaign we need to win.
Thanks for all you do, Alexis Goldstein

* * *
Dear Friend, My name is Kimberly Bretches. I'm a wife and a mother of four young children. And I'm writing to you today because I am out of options and I am terrified. I'll be honest, asking strangers for help doesn't come naturally to me. But neither does the idea of my husband spending the rest of his life in prison for doing his job — so here I am. Chance is a police officer in Austin, Texas. He is, without question, the best man I know. He has spent his career keeping dangerous people off the streets, protecting a city that doesn't always make it easy to do so, and coming home every night to a family that needs him. His supervisors have praised him for his professionalism, for his instincts, for his dedication. He is exactly the kind of officer you want showing up when things go wrong. | By every measure, Chance did everything right. He used department-approved tools, following his training, to protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin.
---
And in May of 2020, things went very wrong in Austin. For three consecutive days, our city was under siege. Violent agitators hurled rocks, frozen water bottles, and exploding fireworks directly at police officers. Buildings were vandalized and looted. Police vehicles were set on fire. A rioter was caught with a Molotov cocktail. Officers were injured. The city was teetering on the edge of complete chaos, and everyone knew it.
On May 31st, the third day, when the mob was larger and more dangerous than it had ever been, Chance was on the front lines. He did what he was trained to do. He deployed non-lethal, department-approved beanbag projectiles to stop the aggression and protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin. The crowd eventually dispersed. The city held.
**No one questioned what he did that night. His supervisors praised his response. His department stood behind him.**
And then Austin elected District Attorney José Garza.
Instead of holding the rioters accountable — the ones who threw the fireworks, who lit the fires, who carried the Molotov cocktails — Garza turned his attention to the officers who stopped them. He launched an indiscriminate campaign against law enforcement, using the power of his office not to protect the public, but to make political examples out of good cops.
Chance became one of his targets.
| Chance now faces up to 99 Years in prison — for following his training.
---
My husband now faces up to 99 years in prison. Not because he did anything wrong. Not because his department found fault with his actions. Not because any credible review of that night concluded he acted improperly. But because one politically-motivated prosecutor decided the officers who held the line deserved to be punished for holding it. This case has been grinding through the system for years now. The trial has already been delayed several times and is **now scheduled for June of this year.** Every continuance, every filing, every hearing means more hours of legal work, and more bills our family has to find a way to pay. I am asking for your help because we cannot do this alone. The National Center for Police Defense has been in Chance's corner, and your donation goes toward funding his legal defense, ensuring he has the representation he deserves as he walks into that courtroom in June.

subject: A quick note

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/finnie_em?refcode=em0614 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/finnie_em?refcode=em0614]
Hey Friend,
It’s Shaun.
I wanted to send you a quick note.
A lot of campaigns spend their time obsessing over polls, consultants, and insider political gossip.
But I'm focused on something simpler: whether we're actually building the kind of campaign that can win in November and flip TX-2 blue.
Every week, I'm talking to voters across the district. At community events, on front porches, in coffee shops.
Everywhere I go, I hear the same thing: People are frustrated.
They're frustrated that everything costs more.
They're frustrated that extremist politicians spend more time fearmongering and yelling about Islam than they do on making our lives better.
And they're frustrated that politicians are more interested in their next TV appearance than helping the people they represent.
That's a big reason I'm running.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Here’s an update on this race →
body:
Texans have been taking notice of Abbott’s poor leadership.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Here’s a quick Texas governor’s race update, Peter:
**FIRST: Greg Abbott has failed Texans for more than a decade.** Public schools are closing, teachers are underpaid, healthcare is out of reach, and families are still living with the consequences of deadly infrastructure failures that should have been prevented. Instead of rubbing shoulders with his billionaire buddies, he should be fixing the problems Texans face every day.
**THEN: Texans have been taking notice of Abbott’s poor leadership, and something shifted amongst voters.** Since January, we’ve seen races flip that Democrats usually don’t win here. Deep-red local and state seats are flipping because Texans are tired of being left behind by Abbott’s and Republicans' poor leadership, and they want change.
**NOW: Abbott is aware of the shift happening in Texas — and he’s intimidated.** Abbott has already said he’s planning to spend _**$25 million in Harris County alone**_ to try to drag it back into the red column. And we should expect the same strategy to happen across Texas.
That is exactly why we set a goal of raising **$300,000** before Monday. We have to prove we can compete everywhere, respond fast, and keep building the campaign Texans are ready for.

I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=2b6bf10b2a2542e693d1f8e7181fa110&_e=J7E-4NEfTHB6Z_Ln-hpWbeWDLcLIAJw_H-p630bAEv1bor07F5yUEV83QteCgVLiVxgxHqoNqJ5CJvK9g-l674Y-TLt78vkZm6x8fiVZYgeZF0VjXPqlVjiatRVXkp42QmfWqkuuT54uwOC1ZQv9yqkJHI3sLgOD_K9Lwdv4mH_x75KUvk0hsYtKZ5rSyKpj4qysby7XgG5P8waoG7d-xO1Mt6cy0DESQEKB6nQTouGnhTKYMgmjTgjDnOxwECqIBxEITKQGm8LKV3luxxBvb0ZDxh7xZ3iYPKcT3x3Kw8dwY2tRyajQ1q8yuVsPCV3xAF7rhNmJ6al-f6ScYM1shju-hkX8DCq7zMlanokVQG8CTj11n7rZ6TzDqdhbO7cO37WO_l8aMGO4rxBi6J596EswmjIiAvH0tb-QXIoXfmlNc5mChUb_isarcAALSNQjDhp9HJqjkzZHaHvVBvWSgYpv-yaNVRB_buGjA_IdZSpgMdupwSpq97IeykFXnSFj1yZf_J4jLfdbmYE_q4d2gN_urGyQAqBCf2E9tDs6IgxulWmrQCbvayEv4v0JsbR3-d-Nq2-mCQKOeM2jZlfsm9Gs9It74-jDp9b8PiFHepDipu67ifW-B6vWZg8LD0etlQdGBLQcIRfSKq2IXfaMMrm6-iX2yuWcGDIij7I_UbuQefGTkL62mWqDBjwl_cEUxdeKoBQbcqw3hktgJ8zDlQ%3D%3D)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=2b6bf10b2a2542e693d1f8e7181fa110&_e=J7E-4NEfTHB6Z_Ln-hpWbeWDLcLIAJw_H-p630bAEv1bor07F5yUEV83QteCgVLiVxgxHqoNqJ5CJvK9g-l674Y-TLt78vkZm6x8fiVZYgeZF0VjXPqlVjiatRVXkp42QmfWqkuuT54uwOC1ZQv9yqkJHI3sLgOD_K9Lwdv4mH_x75KUvk0hsYtKZ5rSyKpj4qysby7XgG5P8waoG7d-xO1Mt6cy0DESQEKB6nQTouGnhTKYMgmjTgjDnOxwECqI2imAyETydOICatn9NkoVLlrDql5NPAdjkauhNwwC2cf20s0aVUlTjMV3N-x_ttwMPrSZ8QaGUG3q5hMEsnsHJuXp8pQ47RzTnwfjaIcDU6OmCiP569l0h3OTQn_pVrRx_GdUg63ZxOc1d_-r7ldLTVsB92E2A4jOJx4NSATzi_BKUGQu8qMsaVtZxy9Ou9IobbX6fP_G1nftGFwj35LcAxjywjyMRAjAksg_gIhM19e_TxktYcZwyxS3b1xnHBkz_3d9lRXX3YRM6_CUzUfvPyUgskPuWND8QN2p8S5az8xQ05ARnTxZUOwD99eDo8GMWynsOcLBP324BgBDohlY7qVnjZ1p4GvTmo6X2_bTi9-px_9J8yJkdtpJ3DsZl_GS-b_ZR1RamijgmQzjcsxO-lKLWiHPNVWnpp8oAEALfej3HjjeKvPjz3_lfN_grWCcUytahaRY3LvP32n493td1g%3D%3D)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=2b6bf10b2a2542e693d1f8e7181fa110&_e=J7E-4NEfTHB6Z_Ln-hpWbeWDLcLIAJw_H-p630bAEv1bor07F5yUEV83QteCgVLiVxgxHqoNqJ5CJvK9g-l674Y-TLt78vkZm6x8fiVZYgeZF0VjXPqlVjiatRVXkp42QmfWqkuuT54uwOC1ZQv9yqkJHI3sLgOD_K9Lwdv4mH_x75KUvk0hsYtKZ5rSyKpj4qysby7XgG5P8waoG7d-xO1Mt6cy0DESQEKB6nQTouGnhTKYMgmjTgjDnOxwECqIal9-cHVKfxnxyt3o0X4kLl_4zAL5NwCL9PU88aDc784TGaGQBZFjjWazzdcRxgsJTRgYCSRTAhH81GUVGJMrVvH6sy1p5ZWk_HeLPjE6TcG8XM9K5PfXdgMzXHLe29Ev9TlcgFkpPb14WwKlNoXvg7FKlckij3j1GRgODXZjciE6HijG8efeTHd5lO6KdsbymbaMkYU0Jvy8yjvWefjycuGbZOvu9TUuC2SgzZPRLolL6MICRzIUDmGNUSKEHvTNN14D6L0jfbyiG22eqiEeJ9mX5KNOM5tXHVZi34Epgjx6FXtBDGyhjDKMHXalvKaWW_V4xdUlM1kSWQWFNl14UdtqrnLLq1pwQecld514dh36LKijGLucGag1ooaNa9vRrXrepS6zhPd4RWrwWPjvpn_k-y64J4OJ2DrOd59SPX-yfJOHCcS5P5FENNob38NGVz8oAom-FW5qenm0aidCUA%3D%3D)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**[Each activism kit costs $25 to pack and ship to a student chapter. Will you put one into a student’s hands today?](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=2b6bf10b2a2542e693d1f8e7181fa110&_e=J7E-4NEfTHB6Z_Ln-hpWbeWDLcLIAJw_H-p630bAEv1bor07F5yUEV83QteCgVLiVxgxHqoNqJ5CJvK9g-l674Y-TLt78vkZm6x8fiVZYgeZF0VjXPqlVjiatRVXkp42QmfWqkuuT54uwOC1ZQv9yqkJHI3sLgOD_K9Lwdv4mH_x75KUvk0hsYtKZ5rSyKpj4qysby7XgG5P8waoG7d-xO1Mt6cy0DESQEKB6nQTouGnhTKYMgmjTgjDnOxwECqIYrx-uBGva2X3gfsT5lVtXitIzPdJEez4JBUwrYT-OQHPqJ27IUyonMXin0caEmn9Qr_VdjwvX2UJ_l2Ji-pTpQcAiEWu7Y4gVPbfx12511kAvdC0R6ez_17T8uhQDxmm_X-bcuWiXo8pe6ZTMGmZJi_cVjDFsmpTgW-kYgKxyHhgypPQv0bYbJrIJ1g9CW8bQF5LNY4hN3BVHzTZ2dRdlx3_f6PNxwLMRkcD_GjJB_2VQ2o_Yms5VYIBQ0-tlvVLYVuDdy1OY-hh_LMB83ce8499aTdVHWr1Ui-_coJm9hIpfayylqUZJ-4AKbZ01dolsZXwBPcgNGSoHE5IsQkGUtbMxvVr5hN0XCk81xPevtOynDiQUmjXcqa-R6GeHJPicvOg6l2dpTM6xJlzt4zxJ26c5rSQ9b4Xw5RpcbHF0qN7XVWCdMkncHfoHSP3d1q_tSROkADSW5ZHIoFCEY5OiA%3D%3D)**

clean_body: We’re trying to keep up... | | | | | Patriot, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. Peter, allow me to speak plainly.The push to make Washington D.C. the 51st state has nothing to do with fairness. It has nothing to do with representation.It is a calculated attempt to add two permanent Democrat senators to the United States Senate — and flip the balance of power in this country for a generation.That's it. That's the whole plan.I've been in enough courtrooms to know when someone is arguing the law and when they're just arguing for the outcome they want.The Democrats pushing DC statehood aren't interested in the Constitution. They're interested in winning.And if they pull it off, conservatives may not recover.[I'm not going to let that happen without a fight. But I want to know where you stand.](https://trk.emails.schmidt4congress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTI1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDYxNF8yWS1JMC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MjUxNjAtMzI1OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA2MTRfMlktSTAuMTEwMTE3X3QxOTI1MTYwLTMyNTkifQ/KObZ3fOidFTVQVV7cf9Yhg)

What he may have done in practice is place American service members in legal jeopardy. Simply put: this violence-hungry administration may have killed the very people they claim to be protecting. We've known for months that Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth - with Keith Self's enthusiastic support - have been pushing the bounds of military and international law with these boat strikes. We've known for months that these strikes are likely illegal, and that their reckless orders may well have placed our own troops in danger of legal consequences. That itself is unforgivable. But now we have clear evidence that the targets of these attacks include the very civilians we claimed to be protecting. Pete Hegseth bragged publicly about dispensing with what he called "stupid rules of engagement", the rules that exist specifically to prevent situations like this one. What he may have done in practice is place American service members in legal jeopardy. Keith Self wore the uniform, too. He knows exactly what rules of engagement mean and why they exist. He understands that cheap plastic patriotism, the kind that posts highlight reels and brags about destruction while gutting the legal framework that protects the people doing the actual fighting, is the most dishonorable thing a veteran in public office can cheer on. He has watched Hegseth dismantle those protections methodically and has celebrated it because loyalty to Trump matters more to him than the legacy of the troops he claims to honor. Keith Self's silence on this is its own answer about where his priorities lie. name: Sheriff Joe Arpaio
subject: Help Free Two Innocent Officers Before It's Too Late
body:
Patriot,
This is a disgrace...and every American who believes in law and order should be furious.
Two police officers—Josh Taylor and Brandon Dingman—are currently serving prison sentences for doing exactly what they were trained and ordered to do: respond to a dangerous call, use non-lethal force, and protecting their community.
Let me tell you what really happened, because the media and the District Attorney certainly won't.
On the night of July 4th, 2019, Officer Josh Taylor responded to a domestic disturbance call in Wilson, Oklahoma. When he arrived, he encountered Jared Lakey: a large, fully grown man walking naked down the street wearing nothing but socks.
Josh immediately recognized this situation for what it was: dangerous and unpredictable. Whether it was drugs, mental illness, or something else—this wasn't a man in his right mind. And Josh knew he couldn't handle it alone. He called for backup.
[Donate to Their Defense](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=df7ea8bc31314688bbc30a82174d5bf8&_e=DdRt3WSJZIwdWK-NYdArgghBdWgQYLyp8vkLREKbtj5dT8AEWFx4piR-Ueu6-gOXATEq3vGy6466Nwd2uqq7qOUIsYEw7I2XrsASSNYIKzJRlBoiQcKnBhEle0rDudpQjNJyau_dC5lZ220g3x8LZWhfQUXnrj1wlUxDhJfO7spfBjcrzZqqYli9Q8_zIdkp2ACMECrw-c-ncacC1TxXV1IvpcQz5SYDUvtsxxE5ueH6Ng58lg-q0Ah8M2EjtRbSRoW_r8_Xm4NeQLLoe2u3V7PSv90onMFHum83N9Vex_CamXF0BpvwI1J1uHQxiPLK59OIRJ_R6w0jmHAPRSNK1C08VSvQpElgfEEBpJhA8Vp90bn3hetf6cfU-lc-4Lh2XU-aH8TFpnTo_qJ3znsnXghEnEbuin6nkP95ZPlNX-wk6wZhaFjQJndwpwcgzMsW)
Officer Josh Taylor
Officer Brandon Dingman
Officer Brandon Dingman arrived on scene, and the two officers tried to do what they were trained to do: safely and professionally bring Mr. Lakey into custody.
But Lakey was 350 pounds, combative, and resisting arrest. When verbal commands didn't work and physical restraint proved impossible, they turned to their department-issued, non-lethal tasers.
They deployed them multiple times, but Lakey kept tearing the barbs out. He was clearly not being fully affected by the tasers—and even after repeated attempts, the officers were unable to subdue him.
Eventually, Josh and Brandon were able to get his arms and cuffed him. They immediately called for medical assistance. An ambulance arrived. Lakey was taken to the hospital.
At that point, the officers had done everything they could—and everything right.
But tragically, Jared Lakey passed away two days later. The autopsy was inconclusive. He had an enlarged heart and lung issues. Drug screenings were unreliable due to the fluids pumped into his system at the hospital. There was no determined cause of death.
Even so, the department launched an internal review. Then the City Council reviewed the case too.
Both cleared the officers. That's two separate investigations concluding Josh and Brandon followed procedure.
Case closed, right?
Wrong.
A full year later, a politically motivated District Attorney, smelling an opportunity, dragged the case back up and charged these officers with second-degree murder.
Let that sink in: second-degree murder. He ignored the internal findings. He ignored the medical uncertainty. He ignored the fact that these officers never even laid a hand on Lakey's neck or airway.
They followed their training, used the gear they were issued, and even called for medical help.
But none of that mattered to a DA looking to make headlines.
Now, these two good cops, family men, community protectors, are sitting behind bars.
The National Center for Police Defense is fighting to overturn this injustice. We're supporting their legal appeals, helping their families, and backing efforts to remove the biased District Attorney who never should have touched this case in the first place.
But appeals are costly. And the longer this drags on, the longer Josh and Brandon sit in prison...separated from their families, their children, their lives.
That's why I'm writing you today. We need your help.
[Yes — I'll Donate Today](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=df7ea8bc31314688bbc30a82174d5bf8&_e=DdRt3WSJZIwdWK-NYdArgghBdWgQYLyp8vkLREKbtj5dT8AEWFx4piR-Ueu6-gOXATEq3vGy6466Nwd2uqq7qOUIsYEw7I2XrsASSNYIKzKQf8mmnXCocGsyQe3uzwVwb7qnctWIGuS37HXR1Hz-aAWHEU_xb0cQsrIv3Gn77vaxpQd2LE0EWeHJSqLZhBwOdOUosMYXrZRc9w_9CRxBt-I_h9wpmMGiT87Y42w50REe3HXDf9r3Iij2UR-MY1MTZz9_f9renyRD9xGRc8I7hQedQ6xfUnWQi-Z4rgfEqO2pA5GLQmuDMRajLPxFnbIxZgbETiJtw9D9prjq3zlzOkyO4qZIFcLeHwurYQYb6AGZsNWLiXtxg5wn_aOWBOz0N-nTrG-qbGCL13jAmZ18InH_rl9rWcIBO_UV3H4ZHZ7VsHTOQV-A1uS5j63V69t-)
We need to raise funds to fuel the legal defense and appeal process. These officers deserve their freedom. They deserve a fair hearing. And they deserve to come home.
We cannot let this go unanswered. If we don't stand up now, more and more police officers will suffer the same fate: thrown to the wolves by political activists in prosecutor's clothing.
Josh and Brandon were railroaded, plain and simple. And now we need to right this wrong.
Will you step up today and donate to support their appeals?
## Stand With Josh & Brandon
Every dollar goes directly to their legal defense and appeals. Help bring them home.
[Click Here to Donate](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=df7ea8bc31314688bbc30a82174d5bf8&_e=DdRt3WSJZIwdWK-NYdArgghBdWgQYLyp8vkLREKbtj5dT8AEWFx4piR-Ueu6-gOXATEq3vGy6466Nwd2uqq7qOUIsYEw7I2XrsASSNYIKzKNWs5Vwv50A4J5cinC74wp1RwemD0WNhfjvFFxkuFBwFjJV_WWlYD29OgnO6Erb3xmJ1Jx9b86By9JteZ0PGCO4rWc4A_WQEz0amRdJT3a6MKYr9mnWkbcjXgP_YHgzlbZldGNHDq7iYYvgseWTlRK84_wxsmXDv47x8vemqk0od0w_k27oeuKWdxDn3GrcfJ2emCVo4cPJGW7ocBhFzlc946CkxVQvxZ4dJay9IWmC8nOwO91z0pQDbwL6Syo9m8VUI0Wzjkc8poSci1PINIZWYj2z9_CX92RebPe4lnI3VK68XJgYsWnCU-dZ-t8NANKFry7HYUMV0M40LdCL-Jn)
Your generous gift goes to defending these officers and restoring justice. No family should have to go through this. No officer should be imprisoned for doing his job.
Let's send a message: we still back the badge—and we won't let politics destroy the lives of our heroes.
For justice,
Sheriff Joe Arpaio (ret.)
National Center for Police Defense | Defenders for Justice

Friend, I’ve spent the last few months traveling back and forth, across our state, connecting directly with Tennesseans over the course of _more than 100 stops_ from the _Mighty Mississippi_ to the _Great Smoky Mountains._ Along the way I’ve met _veterans_ sleeping in their cars, _parents_ skipping meals to afford daycare, and _seniors_ watching their life savings get swallowed whole by predatory medical bills. The heartbreak is _real_ , and the _anger_ is entirely justified. Tennessee _isn't_ broke. _Our government is just broken._ Right now, the state is sitting on** _hundreds of millions of dollars_** meant for families in need, _hoarded_ by a political establishment that cares more about pleasing their corporate donors than _serving_ the communities that elected them. [_**If you are ready to elect a Governor who will actually fight for working families, please chip in right now to help us reach our critical mid-month goal.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133332701/627505553/1843264678?refcode=06.14_MMfundraising&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWZiZDI4Yy0yZTY4LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mPGTfmqU0nSWC6DcxttsSMgpqp1pvg1lzs6SoL8dpSg=) _**I am running for Governor because I refuse to accept that this is the best we can do.**_ I am the _only candidate_ in this race with a concrete, fully funded plan to deliver immediate relief to the people of Tennessee on _**Day One.**_ _**Here is exactly what we are going to do _the moment_ I take the oath of office:**_
* **Wipe Out Predatory Medical Debt: **We will deploy $10 million to buy up and completely _**erase crushing medical debt for over 100,000 Tennesseans.**_ No one should face bankruptcy just for getting sick.
* **Clear the Childcare Waitlist: **We will invest $50 million to entirely **_eliminate the state's childcare waitlist,_** giving working parents the freedom to go to work knowing their kids are safe and cared for.
* **Secure Safe, Affordable Housing: **We will allocate $10 million to _**assist over 100,000 families with security deposits**_ , breaking down the single biggest barrier to getting a roof over your head.

**The politicians in Nashville will tell you this is _impossible._** They want you to believe that _poverty is a personal failure_ rather than a _political decision_ made by people who have never struggled to make ends meet. Those of us who have, know that _this is a lie._ _**We have the resources, we just need people with the political courage to use them.**_ **We can only deliver on these promises if we _**build the movement necessary to flip Tennessee**._** And building that movement requires the resources to fight back against the _corporate donors pouring millions_ into keeping things exactly as they are. _**Our team faces a massive mid-month fundraising deadline:** __**we must raise $18,500 by midnight tomorrow **_to keep our organizers on the ground.
I know times are incredibly tough, and I don't ask this lightly. If you have the means, _**[please click here to chip in $10—or whatever you can swing today—to help us hit our goal and deliver real relief on Day One.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133332702/627505554/1843264678?refcode=06.14_MMfundraising&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWZiZDI4Yy0yZTY4LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mPGTfmqU0nSWC6DcxttsSMgpqp1pvg1lzs6SoL8dpSg=)**_ | | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133332703/627505555/-843357993?refcode=06.14_MMfundraising&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWZiZDI4Yy0yZTY4LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mPGTfmqU0nSWC6DcxttsSMgpqp1pvg1lzs6SoL8dpSg=)

clean_body: | Friend, I’ve spent the last few months traveling back and forth, across our state, connecting directly with Tennesseans over the course of more than 100 stops from the Mighty Mississippi to the Great Smoky Mountains. Along the way I’ve met veterans sleeping in their cars, parents skipping meals to afford daycare, and seniors watching their life savings get swallowed whole by predatory medical bills. The heartbreak is real , and the anger is entirely justified. Tennessee isn't broke. Our government is just broken. Right now, the state is sitting on hundreds of millions of dollars meant for families in need, hoarded by a political establishment that cares more about pleasing their corporate donors than serving the communities that elected them. = I am running for Governor because I refuse to accept that this is the best we can do. I am the only candidate in this race with a concrete, fully funded plan to deliver immediate relief to the people of Tennessee on Day One. Here is exactly what we are going to do the moment I take the oath of office: Wipe Out Predatory Medical Debt: We will deploy $10 million to buy up and completely erase crushing medical debt for over 100,000 Tennesseans. No one should face bankruptcy just for getting sick. Clear the Childcare Waitlist: We will invest $50 million to entirely eliminate the state's childcare waitlist, giving working parents the freedom to go to work knowing their kids are safe and cared for. Secure Safe, Affordable Housing: We will allocate $10 million to assist over 100,000 families with security deposits , breaking down the single biggest barrier to getting a roof over your head. The politicians in Nashville will tell you this is impossible. They want you to believe that poverty is a personal failure rather than a political decision made by people who have never struggled to make ends meet. Those of us who have, know that this is a lie. We have the resources, we just need people with the political courage to use them. We can only deliver on these promises if we build the movement necessary to flip Tennessee. And building that movement requires the resources to fight back against the corporate donors pouring millions into keeping things exactly as they are. Our team faces a massive mid-month fundraising deadline: we must raise $18,500 by midnight tomorrow to keep our organizers on the ground. I know times are incredibly tough, and I don't ask this lightly. If you have the means, = | | = Let’s build a Tennessee where everyone can thrive , not just survive. With Determination, Jerri Green Democratic Candidate For Tennessee Governor = Green For Governor P.O.
