The attacks are getting more ridiculous by the day. | | | Peter, With less than two weeks until a closely watched congressional primary in New York, Working Families Champion Brad Lander is facing a wave of attacks from the big-money super PAC backing his opponent’s campaign. **One of their latest attack ads actually accuses Brad of "helping Trump target immigrants":** [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9UmWopO7SEOJZk32-30S6-8vzYXpKdhqTq0wn9GeKWui9ON3Z7vdGRr_-K0qX5PhWJbSDX3-cMwd9cYYTe_Z8U_6u7U_5lPbSs6W3cuFP_KgexbTJol_5qGaNbjkrVKGVFTv2flVyBWSWfBE7aXfGZWw_eOe6j9O1D4hqJ1bPfFIqNckP3mmTtZjoiWGU6tlnhh83px5akIyOEwBMU3Ca1hvoA2-OZwOSNOjbsDouusnQuZEAjsDaOnJBUSZpmKijVIPjfV3FxwJtnyqOkAW0lSQz4G8YyoBf1nvUSalnrJiRox9C_XqUSGolm34ehtJ0i7vhn67JxFk52r4ZztFlMc15xxvGzqLvFXgyHWC4uWU/4rh/eIElfD0KTgGWa1NSvSFCqA/h0/h001.GP0eewZ-K90jruzyYdqc_mEjz8VMQzv83QFWdrX6P9c) **That is a _remarkable_ attack to make against someone who _literally_ stood trial this week after being arrested while trying to inspect ICE detention facilities where immigrants were being held in unconstitutional conditions — after _already_ having been arrested by ICE while advocating for defendants in criminal court last June.1** That's not the record of someone "helping" Donald Trump, Peter. It's the record of a leader who has spent years standing with immigrant communities and fighting for people struggling in an economy rigged for the wealthy — and who was willing to put himself on the line when it mattered most. **But when you're worried voters might send a Working Families Champion to Congress, the facts can become inconvenient.** **[Early voting in New York started this weekend, and we need to reach as many voters as possible if we are going to send another Working Families Champion to Congress. Split a contribution between Brad Lander and the Working Families Party to help fight back against these attacks:](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9UmWopO7SEOJZk32-30S6-8vzYXpKdhqTq0wn9GeKWui9ON3Z7vdGRr_-K0qX5PhWCMFPe_TIvnVPqy-ILVovhKcPXVROfV0Bo_kfhB5H-Mw8aSjac9soq_EEGXqoDHBYrAJW7a5gpmYjmUnNhevpwLYf0_SBrK1-S7Tj7gRSqH2JBEIusTj8A5lF2ryJx6zG4lvcVmvMWNX-ECFA47XE3Wuf0d0FdftvvJOBUfcmXHnFOYT7o7Jb7IaM2U4bTxzqos5ZS5pCcqMsyiDZlyAAiR31jMbNB5VF_CVRgsMXD4dr8ydJmdMOrAigJgBF3Y_UWVDrPkqH660HclL4zLb1VHl-PBBF7NxAM21qL6P5alA/4rh/eIElfD0KTgGWa1NSvSFCqA/h1/h001.RliBUvX3OKldbd1nyvXfnBh7bKE8-_0BBWK1MO-5hzw)** **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9UmWopO7SEOJZk32-30S6-8vzYXpKdhqTq0wn9GeKWugr-VNWoZxD-e82I1xiMxAnErgFQt0ctA4rQT4pn4otyL33WJLLjUTbqz_X5anaLKjgMkABY2AXwpYt8Xc8NIXeyTmN-h-gaoEoTKV_n76YvxrLHZWbQ9lHpuzeUjHv8xS_suu9TzsoJBgOCFS44uLlzhSBQnkVmpmLKlViCWvl_e4V2U5sjIo1S-LfsEMgUDCJt9aM3lIWqn-_juMi07LJGVWtRHxNdECxX02R6XFevgCFmW1-pRsMg4MiaHJnrvi24PtCPH5Ra-5KejVbq7WpsHM9Km7vYtI7N2gBZUgl-VXmP9RHwesDWEYm6LdnUUE/4rh/eIElfD0KTgGWa1NSvSFCqA/h2/h001.f2bAJgYpVwdAnF6EkTR6oQEjN77e30fsIKxOVKKm3aE)** Brad Lander is running for Congress in New York's 10th District, and he's built a reputation doing something that makes wealthy donors, corporate lobbyists, and the political establishment very uncomfortable: **picking fights with powerful people on behalf of working people.** He fought for better pay and protections for gig workers. He stood with workers organizing unions. He helped protect retirees from being pushed into privatized healthcare plans. He has spent years fighting for immigrants, public services, and an economy that works for working families instead of billionaires. **And now, he's within striking distance of winning a seat in Congress.** That's why the attacks are getting more ridiculous by the day. Dan Goldman and the Wall Street, crypto, and AIPAC donors funding his campaign know Brad isn't running to protect a political system that gives billionaires, corporate interests, and wealthy donors outsized influence over our democracy. He's running to fight for workers, tenants, immigrants, and everyone trying to make ends meet while the rich and powerful continue to write the rules in their favor. **Every conversation matters. Every door knock matters. Every phone call matters. Every voter we reach between now and Tuesday, June 23rd helps build our movement to elect champions like Brad Lander to Congress.** **[Split a contribution between Brad Lander and the Working Families Party today. clean_body: The attacks are getting more ridiculous by the day. | | | Peter, With less than two weeks until a closely watched congressional primary in New York, Working Families Champion Brad Lander is facing a wave of attacks from the big-money super PAC backing his opponent’s campaign. One of their latest attack ads actually accuses Brad of "helping Trump target immigrants": That is a remarkable attack to make against someone who literally stood trial this week after being arrested while trying to inspect ICE detention facilities where immigrants were being held in unconstitutional conditions — after already having been arrested by ICE while advocating for defendants in criminal court last June.1 That's not the record of someone "helping" Donald Trump, Peter. It's the record of a leader who has spent years standing with immigrant communities and fighting for people struggling in an economy rigged for the wealthy — and who was willing to put himself on the line when it mattered most. But when you're worried voters might send a Working Families Champion to Congress, the facts can become inconvenient. Brad Lander is running for Congress in New York's 10th District, and he's built a reputation doing something that makes wealthy donors, corporate lobbyists, and the political establishment very uncomfortable: picking fights with powerful people on behalf of working people. He fought for better pay and protections for gig workers. He stood with workers organizing unions. He helped protect retirees from being pushed into privatized healthcare plans. He has spent years fighting for immigrants, public services, and an economy that works for working families instead of billionaires. And now, he's within striking distance of winning a seat in Congress. That's why the attacks are getting more ridiculous by the day. Dan Goldman and the Wall Street, crypto, and AIPAC donors funding his campaign know Brad isn't running to protect a political system that gives billionaires, corporate interests, and wealthy donors outsized influence over our democracy. He's running to fight for workers, tenants, immigrants, and everyone trying to make ends meet while the rich and powerful continue to write the rules in their favor. Every conversation matters. Every door knock matters. Every phone call matters. Every voter we reach between now and Tuesday, June 23rd helps build our movement to elect champions like Brad Lander to Congress. In solidarity, Working Families Party Source: 1\. , NBC News, June 10, 2026 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. **By Wendy M. Yurgo**
In a few weeks, America will celebrate its 250th birthday.
Two hundred and fifty years since the Declaration of Independence. Two hundred and fifty years since a group of men pledged their lives, fortunes, and sacred honor to create something the world had never seen before: a constitutional republic founded on individual liberty, equal justice under law, and the principle that no king, church, foreign power, or religious authority stands above the Constitution.
Whether one views it as a product of extraordinary human wisdom, divine providence, or both, the Constitution remains one of the most remarkable governing documents ever written. It is the oldest continuously operating written national constitution in the world. While the average constitution survives less than two decades, ours has endured for nearly two and a half centuries and has become the model copied by nations across the globe.
Yet here we are in 2026 debating whether states must pass laws to prevent Sharia law from conflicting with constitutional rights.
How is this even happening?
Why have Alabama, Tennessee, Kansas, Louisiana, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Arizona, and others passed laws designed to prevent foreign or religious legal systems from overriding constitutional protections? Why is Texas still fighting this battle today?
The answer is simple. Americans see what politicians, media organizations, and activists refuse to acknowledge.
They see the demands for special treatment. They see the pressure campaigns. They see the double standards. They see what has happened across Europe. Most importantly, they understand that constitutional government survives only when a nation possesses the confidence to defend its own values.
Look at New York City.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a897530e-d03c-4251-a5c8-9e25c7faac93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

This is the city that lost nearly 3,000 Americans on September 11, 2001 and vowed to Never Forget. Yet today, amplified Islamic calls to prayer echo across parts of the city during Ramadan with the blessing of political leaders. Thousands gather for organized prayer events in Times Square. Public Quran distributions take place in one of America's most iconic public spaces.
At the same time, New Yorkers have elevated Zohran Mamdani, one of the most prominent Muslim politicians in America, to a position of significant influence in city politics. Whether voters agree with his policies is beside the point. The larger question is why any discussion about the growing role of Islamic identity in public life is treated as beyond debate.
Any citizen who raises concerns is immediately accused of intolerance. The question itself becomes forbidden.

_**(Piece continues)**_
Look at Texas.
The controversy surrounding EPIC City was never really about a housing development. It was about trust. Texans looked at a proposed Muslim-centered development containing a mosque, school, community facilities, and more than a thousand homes and asked a basic question: who governs and under what principles?
Those are not extremist questions. They are American questions.
Governor Abbott, Attorney General Paxton, legislators, regulators, and local residents became involved because they recognized something larger was at stake. Americans have every right to ask how communities will be governed, whether constitutional protections will apply equally, and whether religious preferences have any place in housing, governance, or public life.
Then came the schools.
In Wiley, Texas, parents learned that outside groups were distributing Qurans, promoting materials explaining Sharia, offering hijabs to students, and conducting religious outreach during the school day. School officials later acknowledged procedural failures. Parents packed meetings demanding answers. The outrage was immediate because Americans understand the difference between religious freedom and religious recruitment.
Look at Dearborn, Michigan.
Officials correctly point out that American law governs the city. No one disputes that. But that response avoids the real question. Dearborn has become a symbol of a larger national debate over assimilation, cultural separation, political identity, and whether America still expects newcomers to embrace a common national culture.
Americans are repeatedly told there is nothing to discuss. Yet the discussion continues because millions of Americans can see the transformation occurring with their own eyes. They see communities becoming increasingly defined by religious and cultural identity rather than by a shared American identity. They see political leaders unwilling to acknowledge the tension. They see critics attacked rather than answered.
That is why this issue refuses to disappear. The issue is not whether Muslims can practice Islam. They can.

The issue is not whether Americans are free to worship as they choose. They are. The issue is whether America still believes in constitutional supremacy.
There cannot be one law for Christians, another for Muslims, another for Jews, and another for everyone else. There cannot be competing legal systems, competing loyalties, and competing sources of authority.
There is one Constitution.
Every member of Congress swears an oath to defend it. Every judge swears an oath to uphold it. Every elected official derives authority from it.
Not from a church. Not from a mosque. Not from any religious doctrine. From the Constitution.
The real question is not why states are passing these protections. The real question is why they believe they have to.
America's 250th birthday should be a celebration of the greatest experiment in self-government the world has ever known. It should also serve as a reminder that free societies do not survive on autopilot. They survive because citizens are willing to defend the principles that made them successful in the first place.
Civilizations rarely collapse because they are conquered from the outside. More often they decline because they lose confidence in themselves.
The Founders gave us a Constitution. Not a suggestion. Not one option among many. The supreme law of the United States.
The fact that this still needs to be said, loudly and unapologetically, in 2026 is the real story.
Benjamin Franklin was asked what kind of government the Founders had created. His answer has never been more relevant than it is today.
_**A republic. If you can keep it.**_

### About Chaz Molder

| Today, the establishment tried to silence us.
Just hours before our rally was set to begin, our venue canceled on us with no notice. It was the third venue this week to back out of an event with our campaign.
I won't lie - it was crushing. Our team and organizers had spent days preparing, and suddenly we were scrambling at the last minute, worried the whole event might collapse. So, we decided to take to the Capitol to protest against this blatant attempt to silence us - but we had no idea if folks would follow.
But on four hours' notice, Denver came with us.
Neighbors rearranged their day and folks showed up in full force because they know the freedom to gather, speak, and demand better cannot depend on whether the political establishment approves of your message.
That is the heart of this campaign.
When you challenge big money in politics, when you say health care should be guaranteed, when you call for an end to the genocide in Gaza, when you fight to abolish ICE, and when you insist that our democracy belongs to the many and not the wealthy few - the people who benefit from the way things are do not answer with a better argument.
They try to make you smaller - but we refuse to shrink.
While my opponent, Diana DeGette, who has held this seat for 30 years and taken millions in corporate pac donations, launches a new round of disgusting attacks against my character, leans on dark money, and signals once again for super PACs to rescue her campaign, I'm staying focused on working people.
As of tomorrow, there will be only 15 days until polls close, and every day it becomes clearer that the people trying to stop this campaign are afraid of what we are building.
They can cancel venues, launch attacks, and call in anonymous super PACs, but we are not backing down.

clean_body: But Denver showed up anyway. | | | | | == | Today, the establishment tried to silence us. Just hours before our rally was set to begin, our venue canceled on us with no notice. It was the third venue this week to back out of an event with our campaign. I won't lie - it was crushing. Our team and organizers had spent days preparing, and suddenly we were scrambling at the last minute, worried the whole event might collapse. So, we decided to take to the Capitol to protest against this blatant attempt to silence us - but we had no idea if folks would follow. But on four hours' notice, Denver came with us. Neighbors rearranged their day and folks showed up in full force because they know the freedom to gather, speak, and demand better cannot depend on whether the political establishment approves of your message. That is the heart of this campaign. When you challenge big money in politics, when you say health care should be guaranteed, when you call for an end to the genocide in Gaza, when you fight to abolish ICE, and when you insist that our democracy belongs to the many and not the wealthy few - the people who benefit from the way things are do not answer with a better argument. They try to make you smaller - but we refuse to shrink. While my opponent, Diana DeGette, who has held this seat for 30 years and taken millions in corporate pac donations, launches a new round of disgusting attacks against my character, leans on dark money, and signals once again for super PACs to rescue her campaign, I'm staying focused on working people. As of tomorrow, there will be only 15 days until polls close, and every day it becomes clearer that the people trying to stop this campaign are afraid of what we are building. They can cancel venues, launch attacks, and call in anonymous super PACs, but we are not backing down. == | == | Thank you for showing up for me today. I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.

---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---

---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

# [Happy Flag Day!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/06/14/happy-flag-day/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on June 14, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 06.14.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=364068f4e20ba6207a52b35798a6c9a6336c9c059b752e84abe638dd261a634c&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7825&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=72be298cc9dfd7e3971ec40f8bdb77f4&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=215f0a5efbd415b81de4376d68f85b80)**
---
| **Thank you for attending my FUN-draiser!**
---
THANK YOU SO MUCH to everyone who came out for the FUNdraiser at Reid’s winery and Cider House!
---
You braved the heat, gave generously, drank sangria, ate nibbles, bid in the silent auction, listened to lovely music from Voices Three, and shared your vision of a better Congress.
---
I’ll be able to use the money you gave for campaign literature, postcards, yard signs, and more to spread the message of the campaign across our most beautiful 13th Congressional District so that voters send me to Washington DC to represent us!
---
Thank you to everyone who donated to the campaign, even if you didn’t make it.
---
Thank you to the members of the FUNdraiser committee – Lois, Edie, Cookie, Nancy, Angela, Meghan, Claire, and Kathy.
---
Thank you to the volunteers of Team Beth Farnham for Congress – Jack, Sandy, Bretni, Robyn, Claire, and Maribeth.
---
Thank you to the staff of Reid’s Winery.
---
Thank you to Donate, Rebecca, Jodie, and Dempsey for your beautiful harmony.
---
Thank you to everyone who donated to the silent auction.
---
Thank you to Kathleen Pratt for your kind introduction.
---
And thank you to all of the attendees. I enjoyed speaking with every one of you
---
Together, we choose me for Congress because we #ChooseDemocracy !

| **Happy Flag Day!**
---
| |
---
On June 14th, 1777 the Second Continental Congress adopted Flag Day.
---
But who were the members of the Second Continental Congress?
---
They were the Revolutionary leaders of the 13 colonies who had signed the Declaration of Independence on July 4th, 1776.
---
These are the first people we thank for our precious Democracy. Consider their first few grievances against a mad king.
---
He has refused his Assent to Laws, the most wholesome and necessary for the public good.
---
(TRUMP IS VIOLATING CONSTITUTIONAL LAW DAILY)
---
He has forbidden his Governors to pass Laws of immediate and pressing importance, unless suspended in their operation till his Assent should be obtained; and when so suspended, he has utterly neglected to attend to them.
---
(WHEN WILL ALL OF THE EPSTEIN FILES BE RELEASED)
---
He has refused to pass other Laws for the accommodation of large districts of people, unless those people would relinquish the right of Representation in the Legislature, a right inestimable to them and formidable to tyrants only.
---
(REFUSING FEMA MONEY TO DEMOCRATIC STRONGHOLDS)
---
Meanwhile, he grossly exploits the importance of the day with a UFC fight in front of THE PEOPLE’S HOUSE.
---
Of course, our slobbering sycophant of a U.S. Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, silently condones everything Trump does.
---
Vote Joyce out of office by electing me, Beth Farnham because I will honor the sacrifices of every veteran, union member, and activist who sacrificed in the name of Democracy for the Revolutionary ideal – that ALL ARE CREATED EQUAL.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=b42359f534d3c8ab365e45dd8ce719a4364009c2e2073c13b830da1b067c688a&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7825&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=58029b4cca6599de37340aad012efd2a&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=215f0a5efbd415b81de4376d68f85b80) and what the American flag represents.
---
More grievances below
---
He has called together legislative bodies at places unusual, uncomfortable, and distant from the depository of their public Records, for the sole purpose of fatiguing them into compliance with his measures.
---
He has dissolved Representative Houses repeatedly, for opposing with manly firmness his invasions on the rights of the people.
---
He has refused for a long time, after such dissolutions, to cause others to be elected; whereby the Legislative powers, incapable of Annihilation, have returned to the People at large for their exercise; the State remaining in the mean time exposed to all the dangers of invasion from without, and convulsions within.
---
He has endeavoured to prevent the population of these States; for that purpose obstructing the Laws for Naturalization of Foreigners; refusing to pass others to encourage their migrations hither, and raising the conditions of new Appropriations of Lands.
---
He has obstructed the Administration of Justice, by refusing his Assent to Laws for establishing Judiciary powers
---
He has made Judges dependent on his Will alone, for the tenure of their offices, and the amount and payment of their salaries.
---
He has erected a multitude of New Offices, and sent hither swarms of Officers to harrass our people, and eat out their substance.
---
He has kept among us, in times of peace, Standing Armies without the Consent of our legislatures.
---
He has affected to render the Military independent of and superior to the Civil power.
---
He has combined with others to subject us to a jurisdiction foreign to our constitution, and unacknowledged by our laws; giving his Assent to their Acts of pretended Legislation:
---
For Quartering large bodies of armed troops among us:
---
For protecting them, by a mock Trial, from punishment for any Murders which they should commit on the Inhabitants of these States:
---
For cutting off our Trade with all parts of the world:
---
For imposing Taxes on us without our Consent:
---
For depriving us in many cases, of the benefits of Trial by Jury:
---
For transporting us beyond Seas to be tried for pretended offences
---
For abolishing the free System of English Laws in a neighbouring Province, establishing therein an Arbitrary government, and enlarging its Boundaries so as to render it at once an example and fit instrument for introducing the same absolute rule into these Colonies:
---
For taking away our Charters, abolishing our most valuable Laws, and altering fundamentally the Forms of our Governments:
---
For suspending our own Legislatures, and declaring themselves invested with power to legislate for us in all cases whatsoever.
---
He has abdicated Government here, by declaring us out of his Protection and waging War against us.
---
He has plundered our seas, ravaged our Coasts, burnt our towns, and destroyed the lives of our people.
---
He is at this time transporting large Armies of foreign Mercenaries to compleat the works of death, desolation and tyranny, already begun with circumstances of Cruelty & perfidy scarcely paralleled in the most barbarous ages, and totally unworthy the Head of a civilized nation.
---
He has constrained our fellow Citizens taken Captive on the high Seas to bear Arms against their Country, to become the executioners of their friends and Brethren, or to fall themselves by their Hands.
---
He has excited domestic insurrections amongst us, and has endeavoured to bring on the inhabitants of our frontiers, the merciless Indian Savages, whose known rule of warfare, is an undistinguished destruction of all ages, sexes and conditions.
---
| | **Joyce Voted Against Environmental Protection** **Unlike Most of the Republican Representatives**
---
How extreme is our own U.S. Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, in his views on the environment?
---
| |
---
He wouldn’t even vote with the majority of Republicans and Democrats to reauthorize the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative and the Northwest Straits Advisory Commission.
---
While 374 legislators WORKED TOGETHER to pass the bill, H.R.2860 – Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2025, Joyce joined a tiny minority of 48 other legislators to vote against it.
---
What kind of person votes against the commission’s goal to: “protect and restore the marine waters, habitats, and species of the Northwest Straits region to achieve ecosystem health and sustainable resource use?”
---
Apparently, the same kind of person who says nothing about the U.S. President holding UFC championships in front of the White House, failing to uphold proclaimed ceasefires, storming off from an interview with a female reporter when genuinely pressed for evidence about his wildly false claim of winning the 2020 election, and actively trading fuel stocks based on his secret knowledge of what he’ll do next in Iran.
---
But it doesn’t have to be this way.
---
In fact, John Joyce doesn’t really represent us.
---
We, The People of PA-13, can be properly represented by me, Beth Farnham, who will protect the environment and will never approve of a president wasting money, time, or reputation on vanity projects or endless wars that increase our fuel costs.
---
Please vote for me on November 3rd.
---
Together, we[ #ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=1573542ad14ae5775f6066fdf88dbe87797cb12bc71d12b23a2b365ce054bf96&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7825&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=4137fb26a36ea3d7ddeb316b4492abba&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=215f0a5efbd415b81de4376d68f85b80) and a representative who cares not only about the environment, but about avoiding corruption within our government!
---

---
Part of Pride Month is celebrating Reproductive Freedom!
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy and PRIDE to be who we are!

| **June 9th, A** **Mixed News Day**
---
On one hand, 20 Republicans worked with the House Democrats to approve a bill that forces employers to negotiate with their newly formed unions within 90 days of formation.
---
On the other hand, House Republicans passed a Senate bill to fund ICE and Customs Enforcement $70 billion through the end of Trump’s term.
---
While I would have voted for the first bill, I would not have for the second because I.C.E. doesn’t respect basic human rights. Go watch the footage of Renee Good being shot to death if you need a refresher for how terrible they are. And the detention centers, with no real Congressional oversight, are violating the basic human rights of nutrition and sanitation of the detainees.
---
But it doesn’t have to be this way.
---
We, the People, can vote for me, Beth Farnham, who supports union participation and abolishment of I.C.E. instead of multimillionaire John Joyce who supports Trump’s dehumanization of immigrants and is against union participation.
---
Together, we[ #ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=ced6a162caa2e949baad8eaa68d44883fe8abd12db320351cb2067b351452502&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7825&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=c69272b6b57d0b55521eee1996f5078c&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=215f0a5efbd415b81de4376d68f85b80), workers’ rights, and human rights!
---
| |

| **Who wants AI Data Centers to flourish?**
Our own U.S. Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, that’s who!
---
On June 4th, he, along with 2 fellow Republican representatives, called for the FBI to INVESTIGATE opposition to data center growth!
---
That’s right – he doesn’t believe Everyday Americans want to stop data centers from using up precious resources like water and energy and driving up costs.
---
From his stupid letter:
---
“Unleashing American innovation and accelerating new advancements in AI have become key priorities for this committee and the Trump administration, and the US cannot afford to ignore the risks posed by our geopolitical adversaries’ efforts to undermine US global leadership,”.
---
The opposition to AI data center growth is largely AMERICAN, not foreign! Even Republican nominee for Pennsylvania Governor, Stacey Garrity, is calling for a moratorium!
---
These ultra-wealthy representatives just don’t care how AI data centers hurt Everyday Americans, but you can make them care.
---
FLOOD John Joyce’s office with letters and phone calls about why you oppose AI data centers. And tell him his investigation is a stupid waste of taxpayer money.
---
His Washington, D.C. phone number is: 202-225-2431
---
and that address is: 2102 Rayburn House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515
---
Then, vote him out of office by voting for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd.
---
Together, we[ #ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=29859659e5d2bd03450891753f1e34f09ef44cc066d205dad9b3cbb802494d2d&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7825&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=c3672dada3acaee1eae378a5ed5a9225&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=215f0a5efbd415b81de4376d68f85b80), precious resources, and Affordability!

clean_body: I want you to meet Molly When fear takes over, Molly brings comfort, trust, and the first steps toward healing. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Patriot, A child who has been trafficked often learns a heartbreaking lesson: Don't trust anyone. Not adults. Not authority figures. Not even the people trying to help. That is one of the many reasons I am writing to you today. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. After learning firsthand about the horrors of child trafficking, I dedicated my life to helping protect vulnerable children and supporting efforts to stop this evil. Over the years, I have met brave men and women who dedicate their lives to rescuing children from trafficking and exploitation. They walk into places most of us could never imagine. They investigate crimes no human being should ever have to see. They sit with children whose innocence has been stolen. And they carry those memories with them. Day after day. Year after year. That burden is heavy. Sometimes heavier than words can describe. And that is why I want you to meet someone very special. Her name is Molly. Molly is a Labradoodle. But to the officers, investigators, and rescued children she serves, she is so much more than a dog. She is a source of comfort. A source of peace. A source of healing. When an officer has spent hours working a difficult trafficking case, when they've witnessed evil no person should ever have to witness and the weight of the day feels almost unbearable... Molly quietly walks over. She leans against them. And she stays. She does not ask questions. She does not need explanations. Her presence alone reminds them they are not carrying this burden by themselves. Sometimes that simple moment is enough to help someone breathe again. But Molly's work does not stop there. Some of the children rescued from trafficking are terrified, confused, and broken. Many have been manipulated for so long that they do not immediately trust the people trying to help them. Imagine that. Rescue has arrived. But trauma has taught them to fear everyone. Then Molly enters the room. No uniform. No questions. No pressure. Just gentleness and love. And somehow, walls begin to come down. Small hands reach out. Tears begin to flow. Fear begins to soften. And healing can begin. That healing does not happen by accident. It happens because one of our trusted anti-trafficking partners walks alongside survivors and the agencies that serve them. They provide trauma-informed support, resources, and advocacy for lives shattered by trafficking. Every day, they help children move from fear to freedom, from exploitation to safety, and from hopelessness to renewed hope. I have seen firsthand how powerful these moments can be. They remind me of the words of Jesus: "Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them." (Matthew 19:14) Every child deserves safety, protection and every child deserves to know they are loved. And sometimes God uses something as simple as a dog named Molly to help a hurting child take the first step toward healing. What many people do not realize is that dogs like Molly require up to two years of specialized training. They are carefully prepared to remain calm in chaotic situations. They comfort children experiencing trauma and support officers carrying enormous emotional burdens. They serve in places where hope can feel hard to find. This training, care, and support are only possible because compassionate people choose to stand with this mission. Every rescue operation involves people willing to walk into darkness so others can find freedom. But even heroes need support. And so do the children they serve. And sometimes healing begins with four paws, a gentle heart, and a quiet presence named Molly. Today, I am asking if you will become part of that healing. Because every child matters. Every rescue matters. And every act of compassion matters. Will you make your first gift today? Together, we can help protect God's children and bring light into some of the darkest places on earth. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Molly cannot rescue a child by herself. Hey , Cait here. This email isn’t going out to everyone. It’s just going to a select crew of folks like you that we have been hoping to win over to our team in this fight for NY-17. I need to ask a favor, and I’m hoping you’re someone who can help. Our primary is coming up in just over a week. Early voting began yesterday. Ballots are being processed. We are racing against the clock to reach every possible voter and correct the lies my opponent is telling about me. Right now, we’re trying to raise another roughly $15,000 online before the primary. That number wasn’t pulled out of thin air. It’s exactly what we’ve budgeted for to help us afford the TV ads, volunteer materials, and everything else we need to win. That’s why I’m turning to you. | | | Hi Peter!
Thank you for signing up to follow Vic Mellor’s campaign for Rhode Island’s 2nd District. We’re truly grateful for your interest and support.
We’re building a campaign focused on working families, affordability, jobs, freedom, and common-sense leadership, and we’re so glad you want to be part of this effort.
You’ll now be included in our weekly newsletter where we’ll share campaign updates, upcoming events, and ways to get involved.

---
| | |
---
| | |
## The Momentum is Real
---

| We’re just getting started—and the momentum is building across Rhode Island. The conversation is growing, and more Rhode Islanders are stepping up to be part of it.
---

| | | One of the most important ways we can keep the momentum going is by connecting with more Rhode Islanders online. Social media helps us share updates, rally moments, and the message of putting Rhode Island first with people across the state.
If you haven’t already, we’d love you to follow along and stay connected. When you follow, you’ll see rally photos, short videos, and updates about upcoming events.
And if you enjoy a post, one more thing you can do that helps tremendously is **share one of the posts with a friend** who cares about Rhode Island’s future. Every new supporter helps the message reach further.

Hey, Peter – just wanted to make sure you got Roy’s message.
| | Hey, Peter – just following up to make sure you got Roy’s message.

We’re in a tough spot, and the only way we can get out of it is with your grassroots support. Whether you’re able to chip in $10 or even just a few bucks, you’ll be making a huge difference in the fight to flip North Carolina blue and win back the Senate for Democrats.

Can Roy count on you to help us reach our crucial mid-month fundraising goal before tomorrow’s deadline? You can use the link below to donate:

Thanks so much,
Andy, Team Cooper
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)**
Date: Sun, Jun 14, 2026
Subject: Tough news
| | |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk594-v2&amount=10&t=17&akid=1768%2E124072%2EFo6WFA)
Peter,

I just got out of a meeting with my finance team and have some tough news to share.
Grassroots donations to our campaign have slowed down significantly over the past several days, putting us behind our original projections for this point in the month.
**[If we’re able to raise another $750,000 before our mid-month deadline, we can get back on track. I know this team can get there, so I have to ask: Can I count on your donation to help us close the gap?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk594-v2&amount=10&t=18&akid=1768%2E124072%2EFo6WFA)**

My team and I talked through a couple of strategies to get us over this hump.
**We either need to see lots of contributions come through the door today and tomorrow – or we need those who _do_ chip in to give a bit more than usual.**
Normally, we ask folks making their first donation to give just $5. Today, I’m hoping you’ll give a little bit more.
**[With the GOP pouring nearly $100 million so far into this race to defeat me, we can’t afford to keep falling behind on our fundraising – and risk our chances of flipping this seat and the U.S. Senate. Will you chip in $10, or even $15, today?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk594-v2&amount=10&t=20&akid=1768%2E124072%2EFo6WFA)**

Roy

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, I just got
off the phone with my campaign manager.

I’ll spare you all the details, but the topline is this: We need to raise
exactly $21,843 before midnight tomorrow to hit our mid-month fundraising
goal and keep our Ads Fund well-stocked for the fights ahead of us.

Trust me, I know you’d rather be spending your weekend doing anything
other than reading a fundraising email like this. Frankly, there’s a lot
of things I’d rather be doing than writing this message asking for your
hard-earned money. But I wouldn’t be reaching out if it wasn’t extremely
important.

Right now, the Governor’s seat is the very last line of defense between
our Commonwealth and a far-right takeover. So if our fundraising slows
down — and we lose this election because of it — there are no second
chances. No do-overs. No one is coming around to save us if we fall short.

If you have been waiting for the perfect time to make your first contribution to Jon Ossoff's campaign for U.S. Senate, this is the moment.
President Trump just endorsed our potential opponent, Mike Collins.

These endorsements come with an avalanche of press, enthusiasm, and cash for our potential opponent. And remember, Trump has a $300 million war chest stockpiled and ready to spend on his favorite candidates this cycle.
So we are looking for a huge number of donations today in response.
Something that sends a message that Donald Trump can pick a candidate, he can spend as much as he wants to try and defeat Jon Ossoff, but we are going to hold this seat.
